method.artwork: 30 theme maps and 6 four-crop tree-removal fill sheets generated by image_gen, using original maps as input. No code-painted trees, flowers, snow or stars.
method.position_matching: Generated art resized and locally registered to original oval soil/snow interiors. Oak RGB and independent binary semantic selection registered to original zone oak pixel_box.
method.selection: Mask first: source zone v7 prior plus per-theme GrabCut segmentation, largest component and filled holes. No mask inferred from source/nooak differences. Alpha strictly0/255.
method.assembly: Generated empty ground patches blended into each themed map before positioning the generated oak. Deliverable source is fixed before layer extraction. Final oak RGB equals source*mask; nooak changes source only inside that mask, recomposition is pixel-identical.
method.coordinates: pixel_box is [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive. pivot_px/acorns_px/drop_px are canvas pixels. tap is [x%,y%,radius%], radius based on map WIDTH. 8 acorns and8 drops per oak.
method.lot_measurement: Connected flat interior selected by floating-range Lab flood fill, median of local difference tolerances5/6 (fallback4/8 only if necessary); original and themed maps measured identically. Low-contrast stone rims checked against source outlines in alignment previews.
method.preview_rotation: Oak only rotated around pivot_px, nearest-neighbor to keep binary alpha, +2 degrees shown; both +/-2 degrees visually checked.
